title: Zesty Roasted Ukrainian Almond Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Ukrainian dish featuring almond flour and cooked in a tagine style, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle over medium heat
In a large bowl, mix together the almond flour, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir until well combined
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and coat with the almond flour mixture
Add the olive oil to the preheated tava griddle and swirl to coat
Add the chicken breast to the tava griddle and cook for 5 minutes per side
Add the chicken broth to the tava griddle and bring to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes
Remove the chicken from the tava griddle and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
